title: The Fall of the Berlin Wall
prompt: Explain why the fall of the Berlin Wall was a significant event in world history.
hint: Consider the political, social, and symbolic impacts of the Berlin Wall's fall.
sample: The fall of the Berlin Wall marked the end of the Cold War division between East and West Germany, symbolizing the triumph of freedom and democracy over oppression.

title: Life in East and West Berlin

title: The Role of Gorbachev's Reforms
prompt: Explain how Gorbachev's policies of Glasnost and Perestroika influenced the fall of the Berlin Wall.

sample: Gorbachev's Glasnost and Perestroika introduced openness and restructuring, which encouraged more freedom and criticism, leading to increased demands for change in Eastern Europe.

title: The Impact of the Press Conference Mistake
prompt: Describe how a misunderstanding at a press conference contributed to the fall of the Berlin Wall.

sample: A government spokesperson mistakenly announced that travel restrictions were lifted immediately, causing crowds to gather and border guards to open the gates, leading to the Wall's fall.
